[attribute-xtarget]
=== `@xtarget` External Target (TBX)

The `@xtarget` attribute can be used to point to a location external to the current document.

#### OPTIONAL on elements:  <<element-tbx-entailedTerm,`<tbx:entailedTerm>`>>, 
                  <<element-tbx-source,`<tbx:source>`>>

|===
| Value| Meaning| Behavior

| Text, numbers, or special characters| A pointer (which may be a URL) to an external resource| Can be used to make this element a live link to a related site
| Restriction|2+| This is an optional attribute; there is no default.
|===
#### REQUIRED on many elements; click for list and usage

<<element-tbx-externalCrossReference,`<tbx:externalCrossReference>`>>, <<element-tbx-xGraphic,`<tbx:xGraphic>`>>, <<element-tbx-xMathML,`<tbx:xMathML>`>>, <<element-tbx-xSource,`<tbx:xSource>`>>
|===
| Value| Meaning| Behavior

| Text, numbers, or special characters| A pointer (which may be a URL) to an external resource| Can be used to make this element a live link to a related site
| Restriction|2+| This attribute is required; it must be provided if the element is used.
|===
